description: Works out a restaurant's monthly budget from the owner's expected sales and type of restaurant, as the free restaurant budget calculator on restaurantdoctorai.com does: food and drink, labor, prime cost and rent with utilities as money ranges by RestaurantDoctorAI's targets for that type, other operating costs at the owner's share or a 20% working assumption, what's left after every bill, and break-even sales with labor counted both ways. Takes expected net sales and the type, plus optional rent, the owner's own pay and the other costs share, in any currency; a figure that isn't sent is never counted as 0. Returns the calculator's result, how it was worked out, and a link that opens the calculator with the same figures filled in. The figures aren't stored; only an anonymous daily count of calculator runs is kept.

format.description: The type of restaurant, which sets RestaurantDoctorAI's targets the budget is split by: quick_service = Quick service (Counter or kiosk, fast turnover); fast_casual = Fast casual (Order at the counter, served at the table); full_service = Full service / casual dining (Servers, moderate check); fine_dining = Fine dining (Chef-driven, higher check); bar_lounge = Bar, taproom or lounge (Drinks are about half of sales or more); cafe = Café or coffee shop (Drinks lead, with pastries and light food).

anyOf.description: Optional: other operating costs as a % of sales (card fees, packaging, cleaning, repairs, marketing, insurance, software, accounting, loan payments). Left out, 20% is used: a working assumption, not a target or a published figure.
Optional: the owner's own pay for a month, when it isn't on payroll. Comes off what's left, and counts as a bill that stays the same.
Optional: the owner's own rent, property charges and utilities for a month, together, as the occupancy targets count them. Replaces the occupancy range.
Expected net sales for one month, in the owner's own currency like every figure here: before tax and tips. Needed for a result, and more than 0; if missing, the reply asks for it.

name: restaurantdoctor_restaurant_budget

breakEven.description: With the budget at the top of the targets, rounded up to the unit.

anyOf.description: The same, with labor as a bill that stays the same.
Sales a month to break even with labor rising with sales.

checks.description: Figures that look like a slip.

left.description: Left over after every bill, before income tax, not profit; low is the budget at the top of the targets.

lines.description: A month, low to high, money to the unit. primeCost is food and drink plus labor, a subtotal.

basis.description: target: RestaurantDoctorAI's targets; yours: the owner's figure; assumption: the working assumption.

link.description: Opens the calculator with these figures.

otherCostsAssumed.description: True when the other operating costs share is the working assumption.

anyOf.description: The owner's rent against the occupancy ceiling, the top of the range: within it or over it.

result.description: The result in the page's words, in its order.

title: Restaurant budget calculator
